calendarCommandHelp.intro: Use these commands in a room where calendar commands are enabled.
requirements: Read events: calendar access must be enabled, a calendar must be bound to this room, and you must be a current room member.
Create or delete events: the server must also enable event writes, and you need the room's current event-write permission.

Room setup is separate and must be enabled by the server. The caller must be a joined member with calendar-manage permission from an allowed Matrix server. Invite the bot first; it needs permission to send messages and add widgets. The room must be confirmed unencrypted.
For other calendar management, use the Matrix Calendar widget if your client supports widgets.

commands.description: List events in the next 30 days. Default: 5; maximum: 10. Times default to UTC.
Show one event using the .ics resource ID from !calendar upcoming.
Create one timed event. Quote the title and optional description. The timezone defaults to UTC.
Delete a supported event resource and its full recurrence series. !calendar cancel is an alias.
Set up this room calendar and add its widget.

intro: Hello {{userDisplayName}}, thank you for inviting me to the {{originalRoomName}}.
I would be happy to help you set up your calendar in that room.

In order for me to add the calendar function to your room, please give me the necessary right to add widgets to the room {{originalRoomName}} (The Moderator role for example). You can do so in my user profile that you can find in the right side menu via the "info"-icon.
If you do not want to give me the necessary permissions, you can add the calendar function to your room manually by sending the following Message into the room: /addwidget {{widgetURL}}
To get an overview of all commands you can send !meeting help
